note: Adapted from the species-level description of Emerson (1928), originally in English; the original title is OCR’d as “Microtomies sjostedti, new species”, i.e. Microtermes sjostedti; only the soldier is recorded, the worker is merely mentioned as collected in the same series and is not described; synonymy, figure numbers, localities, the derivation of the name and the collection records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head broadly oval, yellow; densely covered with rather long setae. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 smaller than segment 4, segment 4 smaller than segment 2. Labrum rather long, more than half the mandible length. Mandibles slender and elongate, curved apically; inner margin of the left mandible smooth; inner margin of the right mandible with faint traces of two teeth, one beyond the middle and one near the basal condyle. Anterior margin of the pronotum concave, posterior margin weakly concave. Head length 1.63 mm; head width 0.97 mm; antennal length 1.33 mm; pronotum at the middle (length) 0.43 mm, total length 0.50 mm, width 0.73 mm; hind tibia length 0.93 mm; left mandible length 0.73 mm.
